feed.title: WinNewsReader News
feed.subtitle: What's new in WinNewsReader, a feed reader for Windows in the spirit of NetNewsWire.

entry.title: Utility windows, a column layout and a status bar
entry.summary: Current Activity, Activity Log, Error Log, Account Stats and Dinosaurs windows (Ctrl+6 to Ctrl+9); a table-style column layout with sorting by feed, title, unread and starred; Group by Feed; a search scope button; a status bar with a selection menu, a theme menu and click-to-cycle counts; and dragging links onto the sidebar to subscribe.

entry.title: Find in Article, undo, and a taskbar badge
entry.summary: Ctrl+F finds text in the article you're reading, Ctrl+Z undoes marking read or starred and deleting a feed or folder, the taskbar icon shows your unread count, and feeds show their sites' icons.

entry.title: WinNewsReader is in development
entry.summary: WinNewsReader is a Windows port of NetNewsWire that reads RSS, Atom, JSON Feed and RSS-in-JSON, keeps your feeds on your PC or syncs with FreshRSS, and uses NetNewsWire's article themes. It isn't released yet; the source is on GitHub and an installer is still to come.
